message: 🚨 ALERT: data-pipeline ETL job failed. order_analytics table has NULL constraint violations.
The 'status' column was added by last night's migration but it's all NULLs. The backfill migration failed. Checking why.

migration_043 (backfill) depends on a function defined in migration_044, but migrations run in order. 043 ran first, couldn't find the function, and failed. 042 (add column) had already committed, so we have the column with no data.
That's my fault. I split the original migration into 3 parts but numbered them wrong. 044 should have been 043 and vice versa.
OK. The fix is to manually run 044 first, then re-run 043. But we also need to re-run the ETL pipeline to fix the analytics data.
All fixed. Migrations complete, pipeline re-run, analytics data is clean. Dashboards look normal now.
